records.subject: You're in -- let's get Blue Media set up
records.body:
Hi Lin,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Blue Media* just joined on the starter plan!

decisions.rationale: Project created day 0 (2026-07-26) then no activity for 6 days; no invites sent, no tickets, and no reply to either outreach ([email:d962c856], [email:47f9459c]). Silent, self-serve Starter account with 8 days left — unaided activation unlikely but not impossible.

draft.subject: A hand with your next step in Wrenfield?
draft.body:
Hi Lin,

You've got your first project set up in Wrenfield — nice start. The usual next step from there is adding a few tasks inside it, since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them.

If it would help to have your team in there too, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week work? I'm happy to walk through whichever piece is most useful for Blue Media.

Best,
Chidi
